fundamentals.name: Astera Labs, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Astera Labs, Inc. designs, manufactures, and sells semiconductor-based connectivity solutions for cloud and AI infrastructure in Taiwan and the United States. It offers an intelligent connectivity platform, comprised of semiconductor-based, high-speed, mixed-signal connectivity products that integrate a matrix of microcontrollers and sensors, and COSMOS. The company provides COSMOS software suite, a connectivity system management and optimization software that enables management and optimization of resources for large fleets at cloud-scale via link, fleet, and RAS management capabilities. In addition, it offers PCIe/CXL smart DSP retimers and cable modules; ethernet smart cable modules for cloud and AI infrastructure; CXL memory connectivity controllers; and smart fabric switches. The company serves hyperscalers and system original equipment manufacturers. Astera Labs, Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is based in San Jose, California.

judgment.summary: Rapidly growing, highly profitable company with strong margins and a clean balance sheet, albeit trading at a premium valuation.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat EPS estimates by 13.5%; next earnings date is 2026-08-04.
positives: Revenue growth 93.4% YoY and Earnings growth 144.4% YoY indicate strong top and bottom line expansion.
Gross margin 76.0%, Operating margin 20.1%, and Profit margin 26.7% demonstrate excellent profitability.
Return on equity 21.1% and Return on assets 10.1% show efficient use of capital.
Current ratio 11.30 and Quick ratio 10.55 indicate strong short-term liquidity.
Total debt $41.85M vs Total cash $1.18B results in very low net leverage.
negatives: Trailing P/E 226.18 and Forward P/E 79.04 suggest a very high valuation.
Price/Sales (TTM) 56.91 also indicates a premium valuation relative to sales.
Debt/Equity 2.80, while offset by high cash, is notable.
Beta 3.96 indicates high volatility relative to the market.
Analyst mean target of $244.97 is significantly below the current spot price.

news.paragraph: Astera Labs has seen significant positive momentum, with shares soaring over 200% in three months and 70% since its last earnings report. Recent analyst upgrades, like Barclays raising its price target due to a product portfolio ramp-up, highlight strong underlying business performance. The stock's rapid ascent suggests high investor expectations, making its sustainability a key question.
